title: Toolbox
toolLinkDescription: Paste a platform link to open the room or copy its address.
toolNetworkDescription: Test each platform's endpoint for reachability and latency.
toolCacheDescription: Inspect and clear the memory the image cache holds.
toolLogsDescription: Inspect the app's runtime log and diagnostics.
linkFieldHint: Paste a room link or shared text
linkClipboardRooms: Detect room links in the clipboard
linkClipboardRoomsDesc: Reads the clipboard when the app comes back and asks before opening a supported platform link; it never jumps on its own.
linkUnsupported: This link is not recognised; the platform is not supported yet.
linkTimeout: The resolve timed out; check the network and try again.
linkFailed: The resolve failed; try again later.
linkSupportHint: Room links of these platforms resolve and open directly.
networkUnsupported: This platform cannot be probed yet.
cacheClearDesc: Release the memory the image cache holds; favorites and history are untouched.
cacheConfirmDesc: Loaded images download again; favorites and history are untouched.
comingSoonDesc: This tool is not finished yet; stay tuned.
linkDirectEmpty: No stream link is available for this room right now
linkDirectFailed: Could not read the stream links
nodeHint: Run a check to test this platform.
logsFileDesc: Keep a rotating log (pure_live.log) in the app data directory; off keeps only the in-memory ring.
logsExportDesc: Copy the in-memory records to the clipboard.
logsClearDesc: Clears the in-memory records; files already written stay.
logsClearConfirmDesc: The in-memory records are deleted; log files are untouched.
logsEmptyDescription: Startup, network requests and errors appear here.
logsAutoOff: Auto-scroll off (scroll to the bottom to resume)
logsDirectoryDefault: The log file is not ready yet.
logsOpenFailed: Could not open the log directory
